verdict.rationale: Enterprise provisioning APIs for ordering, assignment and FIDO pre-registration are a fair question for a security-key vendor, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a local device CLI (list, LED admin, firmware update) and attestation-key customization for builders, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The storefront llms.txt is a Shopify-generated shopping-agent file from the host platform, not a product provisioning API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive key provisioning end to end — ordering, assignment, pre-registration — through documented enterprise APIs instead of a human-only console
